reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 12 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged external-02 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full repair-agent white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; verified the separated upper/lower cap badges, restored dark right-edge tab rather than a fold/notch, two note rows, two-bar collar tabs, portrait, backing and transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The separate small upper cap emblem and lower circular badge remain above the silver braided band, not merged into one leaf cluster. Native right-edge inspection confirms a distinct compact dark tab in the expected position, not the prior triangular paper fold or notch. The note retains TWO compact upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper, with no third row. Covered hair, dark brows, no glasses, no moustache or beard and one serious closed mouth remain. The near-frontal upright pose, direct gaze, crop and under-cap shadow remain. The dark charcoal high-collared uniform keeps one pale two-bar tab on each visible collar side, with a short broad fitted neck and no stalk or pinching. The complete dark frame and opaque dark green-grey/charcoal backplate remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha viewing; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and near-opacity values alone were not rejection grounds.
entries.visible_limitations: Internal ornament of the tiny cap badges, collar details and exact note glyphs are unreadable at 65x67; the review verifies separated badge arrangement, visible two-row footprint, dark tab construction and portrait/collar features without transcribing microscopic symbols or lettering.
